defects.description: Artifact memoization uses the version alone, so warming a label in one environment makes another environment receive that artifact.

trigger.input: Catalog contains west/r1 digest w and east/r1 digest e. Publish west/r1 as a, then east/r1 as b on the same dispatcher and collect.
trigger.expected: a has artifact w and b has artifact e

defects.why_missed: The suite uses one environment and distinct version labels; it has no multi-environment catalog or cache-warming scenario.

defects.description: Collection applies transient delivery retention to durable deliveries, silently removing outstanding work.

trigger.input: Use clock ()=>now and retention 10. Publish durable a and transient b at now=0; collect, advance now to 11, collect again.
trigger.expected: first collection includes both; second includes only durable a

defects.why_missed: All existing tests use the default clock and collect immediately; there is no clock helper or elapsed-time scenario.
